Skilled in bridging technical and business teams through clear communication and shared objectives. Passionate about continuous learning and adaptability, with a focus on using data and AI not as ends, but as tools to solve real-world problems. Experienced in tackling human-centered challenges and maintaining technical currency through active learning and collaboration with local AI institutions.
